Staff Software Engineer, Global Infrastructure

Stripe
Remote, United States

Stripe is building the economic infrastructure for the internet. As a Staff Software Engineer in Global Infrastructure, you will architect core cloud networking, database replication, and edge routing layers.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical architecture for large-scale distributed systems and multi-region resilience.
  • Design high-throughput APIs and storage engines handling hundreds of thousands of requests per second.
  • Mentor senior engineers and drive best practices in observability, testing, and system reliability.

Minimum Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience building mission-critical distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in Go, Java, Python, or TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of relational databases, consistency models, and network fundamentals.
